purpose: Step 2 version 2 (no daily limit, no time-based retirement; founder decisions 2026-09-28): instruction cost and refusal behaviour of every covenant branch, honest and refused, with 8-decimal token scaling, compared case by case with v1
method: java/KissRunScaled.java: new Contract per input + setGlobals + run, as TxPoWChecker; tokens at scale 36 (8 decimals); every input of each transaction run, verdict = all inputs pass. Texts, addresses and clean-invariance on the live node (runscript). Cases shared with v1 compared against receipts/step2_covenant_branches.json (verdict and refusing inputs).

vaultOp4OnLiveNode.note: the full vault text on the live node with operation 4 (v1 RETIRE): refused

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_1_vault_coin
cases.note: C withdraws 25.12345678 Winiwa from A's 100 load (pooled). No window, no claimed block.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_whole_coin_no_change
cases.note: The whole coin out, no change output (2 outputs): the vault can always be emptied.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_2_vault_coins
cases.note: 2 vault coins (loads and earlier change) in one withdrawal.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_5_vault_coins
cases.note: 5 vault coins (loads and earlier change) in one withdrawal.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_10_vault_coins
cases.note: 10 vault coins (loads and earlier change) in one withdrawal.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_20_vault_coins
cases.note: 20 vault coins (loads and earlier change) in one withdrawal.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_30_vault_coins
cases.note: 30 vault coins (loads and earlier change) in one withdrawal.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_own_coin_added_goes_to_the_vault
cases.note: A foreign coin of the same currency can only be donated into the vault change: SUMINPUTS counts it, and no output can take it back. (Its own script, not run here, must also agree.)

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_xWiniwa_via_Winiwa_dust_registration
cases.note: The registration coin holds Winiwa dust but governs xWiniwa (port 12): a receiver with no xWiniwa in Savings can still move xWiniwa out.

cases.name: NEG_A_currency_swapped_in_state
cases.note: A registration for xWiniwa cannot be pointed at Winiwa (SAMESTATE on port 12).

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_large_amount_no_limit
cases.note: Far above v1's 1,000 per day: v2 has no limit (founder decision 1, 2026-09-28).

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_everything_5_coins_no_change
cases.note: One withdrawal empties five vault coins, 12,345.75000001 Winiwa, no change output.

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_coin_10_years_old
cases.note: A load and a registration untouched for about 10 years still withdraw: no time limit, nothing expires (founder decision 2).

cases.name: A_WITHDRAW_reserved_ports_4_to_6_not_read
cases.note: Ports 4 to 6 are reserved and unused: v2 neither reads nor pins them, whatever they hold.

cases.name: DEMO_T3_C_withdraws_25_from_A_load_of_100
cases.note: C, who never loaded, spends A's load coin: 25 to C's Savings, 75 back to the vault.

cases.name: DEMO_T5_B_withdraws_35_from_change_75
cases.note: B spends the change coin: 35 to B's Savings, 40 back to the vault.

cases.name: DEMO_T6_A_withdraws_40_vault_to_zero
cases.note: A takes the last 40: no change output, the vault ends empty.

cases.name: NEG_DEMO_T6_A_registration_paying_C
cases.note: A's key and registration cannot pay anyone but A's own Savings.

cases.name: NEG_A_payout_redirected_in_state
cases.note: SAMESTATE(0 3) pins the payout.

cases.name: NEG_A_account_id_swapped_in_state
cases.note: SAMESTATE(0 3) pins the account id too.

cases.name: NEG_A_change_understated
cases.note: The vault coin accepts the declared change; the registration coin refuses it (SUMINPUTS).

cases.name: NEG_A_change_kept_with_state_fake_load
cases.note: Change carrying state would look like a new load naming the account in port 1.

cases.name: NEG_A_no_registration_at_input_0
cases.note: A thief puts its own coin at input 0: the vault coin refuses.

cases.name: NEG_A_registration_not_recreated
cases.note: A withdrawal cannot consume the registration coin (only CLOSE can).

cases.name: NEG_A_registration_dust_skimmed
cases.note: The registration comes back with all of its own amount.

cases.name: NEG_A_zero_amount
cases.note: A withdrawal must move something (ASSERT w GT 0).

cases.name: NEG_A_negative_amount
cases.note: A negative amount would grow the change; refused before any arithmetic matters.

cases.name: A_CLOSE_after_10_years
cases.note: The owner can close at any age.

cases.name: V_MERGE_3_coins
cases.note: Anyone may merge vault coins of one currency into one coin that carries no state.

cases.name: V_MERGE_coins_10_years_old
cases.note: Merge works at any age.

cases.name: NEG_V_op4_retire_after_dormancy_to_old_successor
cases.note: Exactly v1's honest retirement (V_RETIRE_after_dormancy): now refused by every coin. Nothing is ever swept.

cases.name: NEG_V_op4_after_10_years_to_anyone
cases.note: Age gives no one a way out: op 4 is unknown at any age.

cases.name: NEG_V_withdraw_op_after_10_years_without_registration
cases.note: An old coin is exactly as protected as a new one.

cases.name: C_WITHDRAW_reveal_next_link
cases.note: No signature at all: works in MiniDapp read mode and on Core without Admin.

cases.name: C_FRONTRUN_same_link_whole_vault_still_valid
cases.note: THE WEAKNESS OF C, larger without a limit: whoever sees link1 in the mempool can post a competing withdrawal of ANY amount. It still pays only the owner, but not the amount the owner's app debited.
